archive.hint: Removes it from the catalog and from new bindings. Anything already using this form keeps working.
archive.purgeHint: This form was never published — deleting it is permanent.
archive.readOnly: Archived form: restore it before editing.
archive.banner: Form archived on {{at}}. It no longer appears in the catalog and cannot be bound to anything new, but it is still served to whatever already references it — until that deployment is changed.
archive.confirm:
Archive "{{id}}"?

It leaves the catalog and new bindings. Anything that already references it (deployments, live contacts, history) keeps working. You can restore it later.
archive.confirmPurge:
Permanently DELETE "{{id}}"?

This form was never published, so nothing can be using it — which is why it will be really deleted, with every version. There is NO way to restore it.
